authorization: Build the first working combined GSO engine, use it to attack the original global bound with any universal finite constant, and preserve all prior results.
original_root: Exists absolute finite C, for every original admissible reachable exactly paired-closed source, Q_B<=C A. Proved U_int<=Q_B<=6A+U_int interfaces unchanged. No Dynamic Optimality claim without separate checked reduction.
implementation_scope: A reusable bounded prototype: original full-tree kernel; exact reachable-pair graphs; free-state potential/positive-cycle oracle; exact finite certificates and reaching-prefix witnesses; registry/strategy gate; counterexample-guided candidate synthesis; symbolic tree/counter induction certificates; legacy exact flow adapter; historical and parametric source adversary; independent verification and optional installed Lean kernel integration. General theorem proving, unbounded-tree SMT completeness, industrial evolutionary search and e-graphs are not claimed.
representation: Original complete paired BST states and operations retained. Numeric graph IDs and depth-threshold features are encodings/functions on original states, not replacement source semantics. Private physical vertices retained; U cyclic predicates never become local pair-edge weights.
principal_new_mechanism: Fixed bounded A-depth-frontier connector energies. For r=1,2,3, E_r(A,B)=sum_v (1[depth_A(v)>=r]-1[min_{x in subtree_B(v)}depth_A(x)>=r]) = |AncestorClosure_B({v:depth_A(v)<r})|-|{v:depth_A(v)<r}|. Include reversed direction. E_1 equals depth_B(root A), which is already in the refuted old linear span; it is a baseline, not new credit.

declared_new_grammars.frontier3: Fixed signed linear span of E_r(A,B),E_r(B,A), r=1..3, constant coefficients independent of source/support.
declared_new_grammars.frontier3_roots_guarded: The same six features plus their products with the physical roots-equal indicator; fixed signed coefficients. This guarded grammar is frozen before testing.

upward_certificate: One single-valued original pair potential and checked reachable-state and A/B loop invariants imply q+Delta Phi<=C a for EVERY original operation. Exact physical pair closure then gives Q_B<=C A. Finite table fit cannot close the root. Ghost banks require an independently proved boundary theorem.

four_gates.strictly_smaller: Implementation teacher is exact on one bounded finite graph. The one global proof attack is the declared bounded-depth connector family, six or twelve coefficients; no arbitrary donor expansion, unbounded representation search or assumed all-source Hall property.
four_gates.concrete_attack: B rotations have exact Delta E_r=-1[min_A(new demoted subtree)>=r] after A is target-rooted. At most 2^r-1 original vertices define a frontier. Learn loop-cost conservation from affine updates, check rotation identities with arbitrary rigid subtrees, synthesize candidate coefficients against exact graph rows, and falsify using complete historical H/W/G/interleaved sources. Seek symbolic all-parameter necessity or a closed induction, never extrapolate finite fits.
four_gates.one_prompt_scope: One working engine slice, one bounded-depth frontier-potential mechanism, two frozen nested grammars, one bounded graph/source audit, one proof/exact obstruction/open checkpoint. Do not silently expand the grammar after an exact refutation.
four_gates.real_upward_success: A fully checked source-uniform whole-operation certificate deletes the whole direct Q_B bound and hence the residual obligation. A finite optimum, learned identity or new grammar exclusion is reported separately as infrastructure/strategic progress with zero original obligations deleted.

original_witness_rules: All reported cycles retain both full initial trees, original operation word, a genuine reaching prefix from an enumerated common diagonal, literal period IDs and exact costs. Prefix work excluded. A trial-C cost violation rejects only C. A candidate-row violation rejects only the certificate. A grammar dual excludes only its proved scope. Only an unbounded original Q_B/A family rejects all finite constants for the root.
preservation: All writes in this fresh versioned directory. No old source/test/config/Git/seal edits or dependency installs. Verify 4583 previously pinned/sealed files (4517 prior plus66 last global-accounting artifacts), all old manifests and selected inputs. Main research in the existing private Notion structure; technical code/README here.
stop: Stop each exactly refuted grammar at its stated scope. Do not substitute a second equally hard open premise for a proof. Record the first missing induction/budget implication if universal closure stalls. Preserve prior results, resource measurements and implementation limits.
